candleglass.name: Candleglass
candleglass.desc: A shard of window fused with votive wax. In ruin the glass weeps out of the frames; in glory it never fell. Hold it to the light and a saint's sleeve is still in it.

sun_creed_charm.name: Sun-Creed Charm
sun_creed_charm.desc: A pilgrim's token: the sun half-sunk behind the Black Gate. The creed ran 'wake, watch, wait'. Three words for a kingdom that managed two of them.

tallow_heart.name: Tallow Heart
tallow_heart.desc: Rendered from a saint's own votive. It does not beat; it keeps.

arrows.name: Lark-fletched Arrows
arrows.desc: Ash shafts fletched with lark feathers, meant for retrieving cage-birds. They retrieve other things now. Loosed from the Larkbow; carried in the quiver, not the hand.

lark_plume.name: Lark Plume
lark_plume.desc: A tail feather of the last summit lark, still warm as a struck bell. The Ferryman honors it as fare — proof the spire was climbed while it still sang.

choir_seal.name: Choir Seal
choir_seal.desc: The Precentress's leaden signet, stamped with the unsung hour. It weights a palm like a held breath. The Ferryman honors it as fare.

chrism_flask.name: Chrism Flask
chrism_flask.desc: Wax-stoppered draughts of votive oil. Kneeling at a vigil lantern refills it; the saints do not ask where the light went.
